setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step pattern through the test MIDI device: trigs on steps 1 to 4 (the channel range) with notes C3, D3, E3 and F3 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97. Tempo is the default 90 BPM, Rate is /1 (sixteenth-note steps, one sixth of a second each) and the sequencer is stopped. The norns shows channel 1's Device screen and every Mosaic option is at its default. UI motion is at its default On.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC and select UI motion in the Screen section. Turn E3 left to Off. The row shows Off. UI motion only changes decoration; it never changes timing or input.
steps.title: Set UI motion Off

steps.caption: Close the menu. Turn E1 to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Clock and press K3 to open the Clock screen (Rate, Feel source, Swing type). Turn E3 to set Rate to /1.5 and press K3 to apply. Look at the mark in the top-right corner of the screen: it is in its rest pose.
steps.title: Open the Clock screen and set Rate /1.5 (motion Off)

steps.caption: Wait half a second and look at the same corner again. With UI motion Off the mark has not changed, and Rate, Feel source and Swing type are as readable as before.
steps.title: Wait: the mark does not move (motion Off)

steps.caption: Set Rate back to /1 the same way, turning E3 and pressing K3. Every label and value stays fully readable and the header mark stays in its rest pose.

assertion.characterisation: Characterisation outside README: visible feedback bound on admitted emulator runtime, no hardware scheduling equivalence

public_mini_header_assertion.characterization: Exact native v2 bitmap, bounded stationary controls and independently checked native musical phase brackets. At240BPM the two-beat eight-pose sequence exceeds the12FPS redraw cap; skipped poses are allowed and complete-loop coverage is not claimed. No hardware scheduling equivalence

steps.title: Set Rate back to /1

steps.caption: Press Play (1,8), let the four-note pattern play and press Play again to stop. With UI motion Off you hear C3, D3, E3, F3 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97; keep this as the reference.
steps.title: Play the phrase with motion Off

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC, select UI motion and turn E3 right to On. The row shows On.
steps.title: Set UI motion On

steps.caption: Close the menu and open the Clock screen again (E1 to Channel tasks, E2 to Clock, K3). Set Rate to /1.5 with E3 and press K3. Watch the mark in the top-right corner: this is the moment it passes through its rest pose, the same picture as with motion Off.
steps.title: Open the Clock screen and set Rate /1.5 (motion On)

steps.caption: Wait a fraction of a second and look at the same corner. The mark has turned to another pose while Rate, Feel source and Swing type still read exactly the same.
steps.title: Wait: the mark has moved (motion On)

steps.caption: Restore Rate to /1 with E3 and K3. Labels and values are still fully readable while the header mark keeps moving.
